note: Cross-model tensions. Trika is the formalised side; the other model is stated and marked formalised:false until it has its own encodings. Every trika anchor must resolve in trika-x EVIDENCE.json. Nothing here is a resolved tension unless a named human signed it.

axes.self: what a self is (substance / activity / construction / absence)
axes.agent: who or what effects the change

tensions.question: Does change add something (an integrated Self) or recognise something already present?

positions.claim: recognition lands on what is already there and adds no content
individuation integrates the Self; the Self is achieved, not merely uncovered

tensions.settling_condition: a durable change produced with no new content delivered and none needed, or an additive intervention matching recognition outcomes
tensions.asymmetry_note: Jung has no encodings in trika-x. Only the trika side is machine-checked; the Jungian position is a stated reconstruction (H), not a formal model.

tensions.question: Is the ego a real but limited contraction, or a misrecognition that must never be made whole?

positions.claim: the ego is a contraction of real capacities; contraction is real but not ultimate
the ego is constituted by meconnaissance; there is no wholeness to return to

tensions.disagreement: whether the endpoint is restoration or the assumption of lack
tensions.settling_condition: an account of what changes when recognition lands, stated in a way that predicts different clinical endpoints
tensions.clinical_implication: both refuse a stronger ego, but diverge on whether wholeness is restored
tensions.asymmetry_note: Lacan has no encodings in trika-x. The Lacanian position is a stated reconstruction (H); the trika anchors establish table structure, not the clinical claim.

tensions.question: Is differentiation constitutive of experience, or an error to be undone?

positions.claim: differentiation is an activity; contraction is a real restriction of capacities
the self is a construction over momentary events; differentiation is not a real agent

tensions.disagreement: whether there is an agent that contracts
tensions.settling_condition: a formal encoding of both where the same observation is derivable in one and not the other
tensions.asymmetry_note: The abhidharma side is formalised only in buddhist/Nanavira.lean (parasite_erase); it does not encode the full no-self doctrine, so the comparison is structural, not doctrinal.

tensions.question: Is manifestation a real expression of freedom, or an error to be cancelled?

positions.claim: manifestation is a real expression of freedom, not an error
the world is maya; the many is an error to be sublated

tensions.disagreement: affirmation vs sublation of the manifest world
tensions.settling_condition: a formal account of what 'error' would have to mean for manifestation to be one
tensions.clinical_implication: engagement with the world vs withdrawal from it
tensions.asymmetry_note: No Advaita encodings exist in trika-x. The trika anchors here establish the count of principles, not the argument for affirmation.

tensions.question: Is the decisive change-agent technique, relationship, or an unconditioned event?

positions.claim: grace and means are categorically distinct; grace is not a means
change is produced by targeting maintaining processes with matched interventions

tensions.disagreement: whether every change has an identifiable technique
tensions.settling_condition: change events with no matching technique, or technique-only change matching grace outcomes
tensions.clinical_implication: whether to treat the unconditioned as a category error in therapy
tensions.asymmetry_note: PBT is not formalised here; its proposition is a stated reading of the process-based-therapy literature (H), to be cited and verified before publication.

tensions.question: Does an unready client make every technique inoperative?

positions.claim: unreadiness blocks every means
any maintaining process can be targeted if matched

tensions.settling_condition: a population where matched process targeting fails while readiness is absent
tensions.clinical_implication: whether readiness is a gate or a modifiable process
tensions.asymmetry_note: PBT is not formalised here; universal targetability is stated as its strongest position (H), not as an encoded claim.

tensions.question: Is the higher stage reached by abandoning the lower, or by accumulating skill?

positions.claim: each rung is resorted by abandoning it; no leaps
skill acquisition accumulates; competence is built

tensions.disagreement: subtraction vs addition as the mechanism of ascent
tensions.settling_condition: a skill that improves performance without any corresponding relinquishment
tensions.clinical_implication: whether therapy should add skills or remove a stance
tensions.asymmetry_note: CBT is not formalised here; skill accumulation is stated as its strongest position (H), not as an encoded claim.

tensions.question: Is change the accumulation of evidence, or a re-weighting of what was already known?

positions.claim: recognition lands on what is already there and adds no content
change is Bayesian updating driven by prediction error and precision

tensions.settling_condition: a durable behavioural change with no new evidence and no value update, or a precision-only manipulation that reproduces recognition outcomes
tensions.asymmetry_note: Active inference is a formal framework but has no encoding in trika-x. The comparison is between our theorem and their published model (Smith et al. 2021), not between two machine-checked encodings.

tensions.question: Is ascent strictly stepwise, or can change be discontinuous?

positions.claim: every resort ascends exactly one rung; no leaps
reorganisation can produce sudden, durable gains when awareness shifts to higher-level goals

tensions.settling_condition: a sudden durable gain with no prior intermediate rungs, or evidence that apparent sudden gains decompose into unobserved steps
tensions.clinical_implication: whether to engineer steps or engineer conditions for reorganisation
tensions.asymmetry_note: PCT (Mansell & Huddy 2020) reports sudden gains in therapy; no PCT encoding exists in trika-x. This is a genuine falsifiable conflict with abandon_strict.

tensions.question: Is the self-boundary a statistical partition or a named restriction of capacities?

positions.claim: five named coverings, each restricting exactly one infinite capacity
the self is a Markov blanket: a statistical boundary between internal and external states

tensions.disagreement: named capacities vs a single measurable boundary
tensions.settling_condition: a boundary measurable as precision/variance that maps 1:1 onto the five named capacities, or evidence that the five collapse into one parameter
tensions.clinical_implication: whether contraction is one thing or five
tensions.asymmetry_note: Markov blankets are formal in the free-energy literature (Kirchhoff et al. 2018) but not encoded here. Our table is machine-checked; their boundary is mathematical but not a Trika model.

tensions.question: Is suffering a covering to be removed, or a command to adapt a boundary?

positions.claim: a covering-chain ascends by exclusion (apoha), with a partial order
pain is an imperative to adapt a boundary, satisfiable homeostatically or heterostatically

tensions.disagreement: removal vs adaptation as the response to instability
tensions.settling_condition: heterostatic adaptation (a new steady state) producing relief with no covering removed
tensions.clinical_implication: cure the covering vs build a new boundary
tensions.asymmetry_note: Prueitt, Sezer & Sacchet 2025 (Neuroscience of Consciousness, niaf049) already bridge Pratyabhijna and allostasis for pain; trika-x has no pain formalisation, so this is their model against our structural anchors.
